main_measure.name: mean unusual 20-bar move of cases (return minus coin's normal 20-bar drift, signal direction)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day combined

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of cases with forecast above median minus below median

reading: Chop is read from the recorded regime and the break from the raw distance > 0 (prices where unrecorded); each 20-bar grid cell keeps its first bet, cases whose 20-bar return leaves the window are dropped, the drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 20-bar return over all windows, and cases at the median forecast are left out of the supporting check.
